label: Signed operands are sign-extended
subgoals: Read each signed operand as a two's-complement value
Sign-extend every operand to the context width
Wrap the result to the target width

label: One unsigned operand makes everything unsigned
section: One unsigned operand makes everything unsigned
subgoals: Check every operand of the expression for signedness
Zero-extend all operands when any one is unsigned
Ignore the signedness of the assignment target

label: Part-selects and literals
subgoals: Classify sized based literals as unsigned and unsized decimals as signed
Recompute the extension after classifying each operand
